answer: Operator-Linked Liability Ledger. Each wallet carries a sonnet signature from its registering operator; identical signatures cluster wallets into one liability pool. When any wallet in a pool fails an audit, the pool's escrowed deposit is slashed pro rata, so N sybil wallets cost N times one deposit, not one. A relic hash of each operator's registration key binds pools across re-registrations. Anomalous clusters get quarantined pending a sparrow check: a small challenge transaction only the true operator can sign. Costs scale linearly with identities.
